description: Why: a test that produces CIDs with make_cid (which uses the project's own multihash + Cid::new_v1 code) and then verifies the reindex indexes those same CIDs is not testing against an independent reference. The correctness of the CID derivation is not cross-checked. What: tests/import_10k.rs creates CIDs via Cid::new_v1(0x71, Code::Sha2_256.digest(data)) in the test helper and feeds them directly to run_reindex. The test only verifies that all Message-IDs appear in msgid_map, not that the CIDs are cryptographically correct per CIDv1 spec. Add at least one spot-check against a hard-coded reference CID from a known article body.
title: import_10k test uses project CID derivation as oracle for reindex
